rca of the issue: Original bug 'fotos desformatadas no relatório' was that the photos on page 3 of the individual athlete PDF were being squeezed into a portrait A4 (~85mm width per box was fine but height was constrained by the shorter portrait canvas, leaving oversized white margins and small photos). The fix changed page 3 to LANDSCAPE via doc.addPage('a4','landscape') and expanded boxW to (297-24-16)/3 ≈ 85.67 mm (equivalent to portrait per-column, but now with much more vertical room — availH ≈ 132 mm), with boxH capped at min(availH, boxW*1.33) = 113.9 mm so the 3:4 photo aspect is respected. Runtime verification confirms: page 3 is 841.89×595.28 pt landscape, 3 body-photo boxes at (36.9,107.3), (302.4,107.3), (567.9,107.3) each 237.2×312.8 pt (~83.7×110.3 mm), captions Frente/Perfil/Costas below at y≈438, filling ~85% of horizontal canvas and ~54% of vertical canvas — no excessive white space, photos are large and well-formatted.
